COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRJA No. 8 of 2025
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J. 
Mr. J.S.Virk, Deputy Advocate General 
assisted by Mr. Rakesh Kumar Joshi, Brief 
Holder for the State.
2. Heard. 
3. This is jail appeal, filed under Section 
415 (2) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha 
Sanhita, 2023, received from the office of 
Superintendant, District Jail, Almora, against 
judgement and order dated 09.01.2025, 
passed by Special Sessions Judge (POCSO), 
District Pithorgarh, in Sessions Trial No. 34 
of 2020, whereby appellant has been 
convicted under Sections 363, 366(A), 
376(3) of IPC and ¾ of POCSO Act and 
sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment 
for seven years with fine of Rs. 10,000/-
and, in default of payment of fine, he has 
been sentenced to undergo 01 year’s 
additional rigorous imprisonment for the 
offence under Section 363 IPC; to undergo 
rigorous imprisonment for ten years with fine 
of Rs. 20,000/- and, in default of payment of 
fine, he has been sentenced to undergo 02 year’s additional imprisonment for the 
offence under Section 366A IPC; and to 
undergo rigorous imprisonment for 20 years 
with fine of Rs. 50,000/- and, in default of 
payment of fine, he has been sentenced to 
undergo 05 years additional rigorous 
imprisonment for the offence under Section 
376(2) (i) (3) IPC. 
4. As per office report, appeal is within 
time. 
5. Admit. 
6. Summon the Trial Court Record. 
7. Mr. M.K.Goyal, Advocate is appointed as 
Amicus Curiae to appear and argue the case
on behalf of the appellant in this appeal. 
8. The Registry is directed to prepare the 
Paper Book and supply the same to the 
learned counsel for the parties, as per Rules. 
9. List on 05.05.2025.
(Ashish Naithani,J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
28.02.2025 
Kaushal
